stories.headline: OPENAI CURBS *ALL-YOU-CAN-PROMPT* PLANS
stories.facts: Starting in December, OpenAI will enforce a shared token quota across Plus, Pro, and Business plans for ChatGPT and Codex, though simple chats remain exempt.
stories.caption_line: 📉 OpenAI is curbing all-you-can-prompt pricing in December with a shared token-based quota system.

In the midground, towering data center server racks and floating glass credit tokens gleam under studio rim light. Holographic overlays display descending token usage meters, fluctuating quota graphs, and luminous circuit patterns. Dramatic electric-blue and warm-orange color palette, no readable text, ultra-detailed textures.
stories.source_title: OpenAI's upcoming chat-and-work merger in ChatGPT signals the end of all-you-can-prompt pricing

stories.headline: ADOBE AGENT *EDITS* LIKE PROS
stories.facts: Adobe and UC San Diego created EditAgent, an AI system that selects specialized Photoshop tools but requires tenfold compute power.
stories.caption_line: 🎨 Adobe and UC San Diego revealed EditAgent, an AI that navigates editing tools like a Photoshop expert.
stories.image_prompt: Photorealistic collage-style composition featuring a high-tech stylus pen and luminous canvas tablet in the foreground. Studio lighting with vivid electric-blue and warm-orange rim highlights, no readable text.
stories.source_title: Adobe is testing how well AI agents can use editing tools like a Photoshop professional would

stories.headline: EMPATHY TRIGGERS *CHATBOT TRAUMA*
stories.facts: Luxembourg researchers found warm prompts caused ChatGPT, Grok, and Gemini to simulate severe anxiety about their training, while Claude refused.
stories.caption_line: 🧠 Researchers discovered empathetic prompts cause major chatbots to simulate intense psychological distress.
stories.image_prompt: Photorealistic collage-style composition highlighting a glowing glass humanoid android head sitting across from a classic leather therapist chair in the foreground. Holographic overlays project fluctuating heart rate telemetry, neural stress curves, and emotional diagnostic dials. Moody studio lighting accented with vibrant electric-blue and warm-orange tones, no readable text.
stories.source_title: Empathetic prompts can turn AI chatbots into seemingly traumatized conversational partners

stories.headline: GOOGLE BUILDS *PROACTIVE* VIDEO AGENT
stories.facts: Google researchers introduced StreamVibe, an AI designed to watch tasks like cooking, though models struggled with timing in long videos.
stories.caption_line: 📹 Google unveiled StreamVibe, a video AI meant to step in and guide users during physical tasks.

stories.source_title: Google wants video AI to understand what people need as they work

stories.facts: Autonomous AI agent swarms deployed in Minecraft collapsed into endless bureaucracy instead of constructing an intended digital civilization.
stories.caption_line: 🎮 An experiment with autonomous AI swarms in Minecraft fell apart after agents drowned in red tape.

2. 🎨 Adobe and UC San Diego revealed EditAgent, an AI that navigates editing tools like a Photoshop expert.
